items.html:
Pawan Suyal is a left-arm fast bowler from the north Indian city region of Pauri Garwhal, who landed in Delhi in the summer of 2008 hoping to further his cricketing aspirations. After finding a place in a local corporate tournament, Suyal caught the attention of the city's selectors and was included in the Under-22 side in 2009. Following that, Suyal was included in Delhi's Ranji probables and made the cut into the 15-man squad for the first two matches of the 2009-10 season.
Cricinfo Staff October 2009
